fields.description: Issue includes local political and civic commentary and reporting, including allegations of graft and corruption involving city departments and discussion of a felony charge and bond status connected to Stanley Massey. Coverage also addresses Miami telephone rate-reduction efforts and state action involving the Southern Bell Telephone Company, labor organizing among telephone company employees, and Florida political campaigning. The issue features Miami Life’s “most attractive working girl” contest (Burdines) and a ballot for a Florida Power & Light Company contest, along with society/round-the-town items, advertisements, and a horse-racing tipster column ("Jockey Jimmy").
